svg.text: Self-intersecting case 1 — arrangement before winding deletion or parity pruning
Green: winding-compatible offset edges · Red: submerged offset edges · Gray dashed: other arrangement edges
Detail near the crossing and open ends
60 arrangement edges: 29 offset-image edges = 16 winding-compatible + 13 submerged.
All red edges are still shown here. Subsequent winding deletion and parity pruning leave only 2 offset edges.
